title: Demon Path Commander's Proposal
next_chapter_hook: As Chen Ji was lost in contemplation, the Demon Path Commander suddenly veered the conversation: "Do you know who has been secretly guiding your growth all these years...?"

text.content:
Deep within the vortex of fate, Chen Ji's divine consciousness seemed gripped by an invisible hand, slowly falling into a chaotic void. Mo Xiansheng's sighs still echoed in his ears, but like distant mountain mist, they gradually faded. He opened his mouth, wanting to ask about the truth from ten thousand years ago, but from his throat came only a barely audible hoarse sound.

Just then, a point of eerie green light blazed in the depths of the void, like a ghost fire in the dark night, drifting幽幽 toward him. As the light drew closer, the outline gradually became clear—it was an aged and withered hand, fingers entwined with wisps of demonic energy, radiating a chilling pressure that struck fear into the heart.

dialogue.content:
"Young fool, you arrived faster than I anticipated."

The voice was aged and hoarse, like a dilapidated wind bell in an ancient temple, carrying the desolation of time and an uncanny quality. Chen Ji felt his vision blur, and that cluster of green light transformed into a hunched silhouette—an elderly man with white hair, dressed in black robes, his face wizened, only his eyes deep and unfathomable as an abyss, as if concealing endless stars and conspiracies.

text.content:
Chen Ji steadied his mind, revealing no trace of fear on his face. He slightly bowed, his tone calm as still well water: "Junior Chen Ji, pays respects to the senior. May I know how to address the senior?" Though he knew the other was the Demon Path Commander, he deliberately pretended not to recognize him—this was both a test and leaving room for negotiation.

The old man's withered lips curved into an amused smile, carrying the bleakness of one who has seen through worldly affairs and scheming: "Address? Between us, why bother with mere names? However, since you wish to know..." His voice suddenly turned cold and authoritative, "This old one is Cang Yutian, Commander of the Holy Sect of the Demonic Path."

This name struck Chen Ji's heart like a heavy hammer. Cang Yutian—the supreme existence of the Holy Sect of the Demonic Path, said to have reached the half-step to Heaven-Touching realm, a true figure who could summon wind and rain in this chaotic world. Chen Ji's face remained unchanged, but his heart was already churning with terrifying waves.

He suddenly recalled Mo Xiansheng's warning just now: "The chess game from ten thousand years ago never truly ended..." Could this Demon Path Commander before him be one of the players in that ancient game?

dialogue.content:
"You're wondering why this old one would appear here, aren't you?" Cang Yutian seemed to see through Chen Ji's thoughts, and with a tap of his twig-like finger, a massive light screen materialized in the void.

Countless scenes flickered across the screen like a kaleidoscope—Chen Ji being accepted into the Tianqing Sect as a child, the omen when he first triggered the Tianji Record, even his late-night conversation with Su Qingyao at the Cliff Edge... One private scene after another was displayed without any concealment.

"Did you think those 'coincidences' were all heaven's will?" Cang Yutian's laughter rang like a night owl's cry, "Fool, every step you've taken has been on this old one's chessboard."

text.content:
Chen Ji's heart sank violently. He recalled his early life experiences—every time he fell into desperate straits, there would always be a benefactor to help, every time his cultivation hit a bottleneck, there would be unexpected fortuitous encounters. So all of this had been the chess game set up by this old man before him.

A chill shot from his tailbone to his crown, immediately replaced by a overwhelming rage. He took a deep breath, forcibly suppressing that fury, and his expression反而 became increasingly calm: "The senior's methods are remarkable. Then I wonder, is today's appearance to reap the harvest, or..." He paused, a cold smile curling at his lips, "Does the senior have other instructions?"

dialogue.content:
Cang Yutian watched Chen Ji's reaction, a flicker of appreciation passing through his eyes: "Unruffled in the face of change, unafraid in times of crisis. You're far better than your good-for-nothing father."

Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply. Father—this word was like a needle, piercing deeply into his long-sealed wound. He had never mentioned his father to anyone, that man who mysteriously disappeared when he was seven years old. How much did this Demon Path Commander know?

"Do you want to know where Chen Tianming is?" Cang Yutian seemed to be appreciating a precious collectible, "No rush, when the time comes you'll know. Right now, this old one has something more important to tell you."

text.content:
As his voice fell, the light screen in the void transformed drastically. The originally chaotic images dissolved, replaced by a breathtaking scene—

It was a vast and boundless starry sky, countless stars arranged like chess pieces. And in the deepest part of the starfield, a blurred figure slowly emerged, emanating an apocalyptic might, as if with merely a thought, the entire heavens and earth could be reshaped under its will.

"Do you see it?" Cang Yutian's voice became unprecedentedly solemn, "That is the Heavenly Eye—our common enemy."

dialogue.content:
"Ten thousand years ago, this old one, your father, and seven other extraordinary talents once joined forces to oppose the lackeys of the Heavenly Eye." Cang Yutian's voice carried a trace of nostalgia, "That was a calamity sufficient to overturn the Three Realms. We thought victory was assured, but unexpectedly..."

His voice suddenly turned cold: "The Heavenly Eye, with its supreme divine power, forcibly剥离 our nine people's fate fragments, merging them into heaven and earth. It intended to use these fragments to reweave the laws of this world. And we... were merely discarded pieces on its chessboard."

Chen Ji suddenly understood something. Fragments from the Tianji Record and the faint bloodline power within him suddenly made sense.

text.content:
"You mean..." Chen Ji's voice trembled slightly, this being an emotion he rarely displayed, "The fate fragment within me..."

"Exactly." Cang Yutian cut him off, "Chen Tianming's betrayal of this old one's chess game back then wasn't treachery, but protection for you. He fused his fate fragment with your soul, making you the vessel bearing the karma of two generations. In other words—"

His gaze was like a blade, piercing directly into Chen Ji's heart: "You are the final piece this old one has sought for ten thousand years. As long as this old one obtains the fragment within you, the Heavenly Eye can complete its ambition to reshape heaven and earth. And both you and this old one will become its puppets."

Chen Ji fell silent. These words struck like thunderclaps, exploding in his mind. He had always thought the Tianji Record Fragment in his hands was a tremendous fortune, never realizing that everything from the start was merely one move in someone else's chess game.

However, there was not the slightest trace of panic on his face. He slowly raised his head, his gaze calm as still water, yet hiding sharp edges: "Since the senior already knows the junior is the key, why bother telling the junior all this? Wouldn't it be simpler to take action directly?"

Cang Yutian laughed upon hearing this, the laughter carrying desolation and heroism: "Did you think this old one hadn't considered that? Unfortunately, once the fate fragment is forcibly extracted, both you and this old one will be destroyed in body and spirit. What the Heavenly Eye wants is an complete fragment, not shattered remnants."

dialogue.content:
"So the senior's visit today is to negotiate terms with the junior?" Chen Ji's voice regained its usual composure.

Cang Yutian nodded, his expression turning solemn: "This old one has a proposal—the senior and you join forces to jointly oppose the Heavenly Eye. This old one possesses all the intelligence about the Heavenly Eye collected over ten thousand years, as well as its weaknesses. And you..." He paused, his gaze burning intensely, "You possess the ability for fate resonance, can perceive its existence, even interfere with its foresight."

"As long as we cooperate, there is a chance to permanently seal the Heavenly Eye before it fully awakens. And the fragment within you will completely belong to yourself."

choice.prompt: Faced with the Demon Path Commander's alliance proposal, Chen Ji needed to weigh the pros and cons. Though Cang Yutian's words carried some credibility, his city sophistication accumulated over ten thousand years also aroused deep wariness. Should he accept this seemingly win-win cooperation, or does he have other plans?

choices.description: Form an alliance with the Demon Path Commander to oppose the Heavenly Eye, gaining ten thousand years of intelligence support, but also being completely drawn into this chess game from ten thousand years ago.
choices.visible_cost: Lose independent freedom of action, must be bound to the demonic path forces
choices.visible_reward: Obtain Cang Yutian's ten-thousand-year strategic intelligence, unlocking key information to oppose the Heavenly Eye
choices.risk_hint: The Demon Path Commander is extremely scheming, and there's no guarantee he doesn't have other ulterior motives

text.content:
Chen Ji fell silent for a moment, his fingers gently tapping the void, as if playing a silent melody. Cang Yutian's words were indeed tempting, but could a being who could set up such a grand chess game ten thousand years ago really be easy to deal with?

However, in the current situation, if he didn't borrow strength, it would be difficult to contend with the Heavenly Eye. Moreover, since Cang Yutian voluntarily revealed himself, it meant the other party also needed something from him. This provided room for negotiation.

"Very well." Chen Ji's voice was calm and firm, "The junior is willing to cooperate with the senior. But the junior has one condition—during our cooperation, the senior must not monitor or manipulate the junior's actions in any way."

dialogue.content:
Upon hearing this, a trace of a smile actually appeared on Cang Yutian's withered face: "You're more bold than your father. Very well, this old one agrees."

He waved his hand, and a beam of eerie green light vanished into Chen Ji's brow center. In an instant, countless pieces of information flooded into his mind like a tide—the weaknesses of the Heavenly Eye, the key to sealing it, and the secret pieces Cang Yutian had placed over ten thousand years...

"These are merely a greeting gift from this old one." Cang Yutian's voice gradually drifted away, "The road ahead, you must walk yourself. Remember, the Heavenly Eye is unsealing in the depths of the heavenly realm—our time... is running out."

choices.memory_label: 与仓御天达成合作协议，获得对抗天道之眼的关键情报

choices.description: Unwilling to make a pact with the tiger, insisting on independently opposing fate. Even if the path ahead is treacherous, never hand over one's destiny to others.
choices.visible_cost: Lose crucial intelligence support, facing unknown powerful enemies alone
choices.visible_reward: Maintain independent status, free from Demonic Path entanglement
choices.risk_hint: The threat of the Eye of Heavenly Dao is imminent, fighting alone poses tremendous risk

text.content:
Chen Ji's gaze turned cold. Cang Yutian had been manipulating him like a chess piece for ten thousand years, and now sought to bind him to the Demonic Path under the guise of "cooperation."

He recalled Mo Xiansheng's warning, the vague prophecies in the Tianji Record, and resolve crystallized within him.

"Thank you for your generosity, Senior." Chen Ji's voice remained placid, utterly unruffled. "But I have always preferred solitude, disdain owing favors, and refuse to be manipulated. Regarding this cooperation—I must decline."

dialogue.content:
Cang Yutian's expression flickered momentarily before returning to its composed tranquility: "Young one, do you comprehend the consequences of refusing this old man?"

"I am well aware." Chen Ji raised his head, his gaze sharp as a sword as it locked onto those profound eyes. "But if Senior attempts to forcibly extract the fragment from within me, you would not profit from it either. Having schemed for ten thousand years, surely Senior would not wish to ruin everything at this critical juncture?"

The two exchanged glances, invisible sparks seeming to ignite in the void. Finally, Cang Yutian averted his gaze first, releasing a profound sigh.

choices.memory_label: 拒绝仓御天的合作提议，选择独自面对命运

choices.text: Biding one's time for the optimal moment
choices.description: Not rushing to decide, extracting more intelligence and leverage first. Since Cang Yutian has needs from him, this represents the optimal opportunity for negotiation.
choices.visible_cost: Risk provoking the Demonic Path commander, squandering the opportunity for cooperation
choices.visible_reward: Acquire more critical intelligence, seize the initiative in negotiations
choices.risk_hint: Cang Yutian is extremely calculating and deep—there's no guarantee he won't turn the tables

text.content:
Chen Ji did not answer immediately. Standing with hands clasped behind his back, his gaze wandered between the star chart and Cang Yutian. He was calculating—Cang Yutian had been scheming for ten thousand years, and now voluntarily appeared to seek cooperation, which meant the situation had reached a point of no return.

This was his greatest leverage.

"I roughly understand Senior's intentions." Chen Ji spoke slowly, his tone measured. "But I have several questions I wish Senior to address."

Cang Yutian raised an eyebrow: "Oh? What would you like to ask?"

dialogue.content:
"First, what price must I pay for the sealing method Senior mentioned?" Chen Ji raised one finger.

"Second, where is my father Chen Tianming now? Is he alive or dead?" He raised a second finger.

"Third..." Chen Ji's gaze suddenly turned razor-sharp. "Senior has maneuvered me as a chess piece for ten thousand years. Since we are to cooperate today, should Senior not be forthcoming—the 'benefactor' who secretly aided my early growth—could it have been you?"

These three questions grew increasingly incisive, striking directly at the heart of this ten-thousand-year-old chess game.

choices.memory_label: 向仓御天追问三个关键问题，掌握谈判主动权

text.content:
After hearing Chen Ji's questions, a complex smile appeared on Cang Yutian's withered face. He did not answer immediately but paced slowly through the void with hands clasped behind his back.

"These three questions cut deeper than I anticipated." He halted, turning to face Chen Ji. "It seems I underestimated you. Very well, I shall make an exception and answer."

He raised his gnarled finger, pointing at Chen Ji's brow center: "First, sealing the Eye of Heavenly Dao requires consuming thirty percent of your fragment's energy—this means your lifespan will be reduced by thirty percent. Second..."

dialogue.content:
When Chen Tianming was mentioned, Cang Yutian's eyes flickered subtly: "Your father is still alive, sealed within a forbidden realm of the Celestial Realm. He sacrificed everything to protect you in those years. However, if I am to rescue him, I require more fate fragments as payment."

Chen Ji's heart clenched sharply. Father... is still alive? This news struck like thunder in his mind.

"As for the third..." Cang Yutian's voice suddenly turned meaningful. "Who do you think has been guiding your growth all these years?"

text.content:
Chen Ji's heart skipped a beat. That mysterious voice, those perfectly-timed opportunities, that mysterious aid when he was on the brink of death... could it all have been this Demonic Path commander?

"Indeed." Cang Yutian seemed to read his thoughts, a playful smirk curling his lips. "Did you think those Tianqing Sect elders suddenly favored you for no reason? Did you believe your 'coincidences' came naturally? I have schemed for ten thousand years—you are the most crucial piece on this chessboard."

His voice turned icy: "And a piece should have the觉悟 of a piece."

Chen Ji's fists tightened involuntarily. Chess piece—these two words pierced his heart like thorns.

He thought of his years of patience and scheming, the vague prophecies in the Tianji Record, Mo Xiansheng's meaningful warning. So from the very beginning, he had been struggling to survive on another's game board.

Yet his face betrayed no anger. He slowly loosened his fists, a faint cold smile forming at his lips instead.

"A chess piece, you say..." His voice was barely a whisper. "Then has Senior ever considered that a piece might have its day to turn the tables?"

dialogue.content:
Cang Yutian paused momentarily, then burst into laughter. That laughter was desolate yet unrestrained, echoing through the chaotic void.

"Excellent! Excellent! Excellent!" He repeated the word three times, genuine admiration flickering in his eyes. "You truly are Chen Tianming's son—you have some of his bearing from years past."

His smile vanished, replaced by solemnity: "I have waited a long time to hear such words. Since you possess such ambition, I shall share another secret—the Eye of Heavenly Dao is not invincible. Ten thousand years ago, we discovered its true location, but fell short at the crucial moment. This time..."

text.content:
He waved his hand, and a more detailed star chart materialized in the void. At its deepest point, a dark point lurked, emitting terrifying energy that chilled the heart.

"This is the 'Abyss of Destiny' at the deepest part of the Celestial Realm—the Eye of Heavenly Dao's true form is sealed there." Cang Yutian's voice was low and grave. "It is slowly awakening. The time remaining for us is limited—from three years at the least to ten at the most. Once it fully awakens..."

He did not continue, but the killing intent in those profound eyes burned like flames.

Chen Ji stared at the star chart, his thoughts churning. Three years... ten years... this timeline was far more urgent than he had imagined.

He suddenly recalled Mo Xiansheng's earlier words: "The chess game from ten thousand years ago never truly ended." Now it seemed the chessboard was far larger than imagined—it involved not only the Tianqing Sect, the Demonic Holy Sect, and the Three Great Sects, but even the heavens themselves.

And he was the greatest variable in this game.

Cang Yutian's voice rang out again: "Young one, time grows short. I have given you enough. Now—it is time to make your choice."

Chen Ji drew a deep breath, raising his head to meet those profound, abyssal eyes. He had already calculated his move—whatever the choice, he would never allow himself to become a pawn to be manipulated.

If there is to be cooperation, it must be on equal terms; if there is to be refusal, he must possess sufficient leverage to give the other party pause; if there is to be biding time, he must extract every last piece of intelligence.

This was Chen Ji's code of conduct—meticulous planning, watertight execution.

However, just as he was about to speak, Cang Yutian added casually: "Ah, there is one more thing I nearly forgot to mention—your sister Chen Nian is also in the clutches of the Eye of Heavenly Dao. If you wish to rescue her, cooperation with me becomes even more essential."

These words struck like a heavy hammer,狠狠 crushing Chen Ji's heart.
